_about: The photographs on the UK's pages, each a Wikimedia Commons file in the public domain or under CC0 (no credit required; kept here as the record of where each came from). Chosen 2026-09-25 on the founder's word ('you choose, push forward'); no stock libraries (the no-stock-imagery rule). Since 2026-10-10 (plan home reform, Task 6) each city's position is the CSS object-position that keeps its landmark in a short row, read into data/cities/images_manifest.json by scripts/build_city_images_manifest.ts.
